test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the center (but not necessarily in the same order). C is sitting to the immediate right of E. D is sitting third to the left of C. A is the immediate neighbour of B and C. F is not the immediate neighbour of E.

What is the position of G with respect to A?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the center (but not necessarily in the same order).

C is sitting to the immediate right of E. D is sitting third to the left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17717ab08b726d1cc547fb68f8d529fc20c8d92da929eda2cd94fd65b9cb326c.png] 

A is the immediate neighbour of B and C. F is not the immediate neighbour of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6535bb6def6a286c937cfe5f202f97df37e5fa65cbd14e6211937345bbeeb12.png] 

Thus, The position of the G is third to the left of A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
